raw_payload.description: Read-only active-host parameter reads. Accepts elementId/elementIds, a strict category/categories scope, or allModelInstances:true narrowed by mutually exclusive valueEquals/valueContains and/or exact names. Use valueEquals for exact identifiers and valueContains for intentional substring audits. Name/value/writability filters are applied before paging; responses are capped at 500 matching elements and return totalScanned, totalMatched, hasMore, and nextOffset. Matching parameter details include exact name, value, storageType, isReadOnly, and parameterId.
